messages:
support-liaison: Customer (acme-inc) reports surge of 5xx and repeated 504s when calling hosted generate endpoint starting ~2026-04-02T08:12:25-07:00. Client logs show \"queue full / request dropped\" plus long tail decode times.

alex_oncall: Can you paste one failing curl + request id so we can trace?

support-liaison: Minimal repro sent privately, paste here for log:

support-liaison: ```bash
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-3b\",\"input\":\"summarize: ...\",\"max_tokens\":512}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -v
```

support-liaison: Sample x-request-id: rq_20260402_acme_A1, server_time: 2026-04-02T15:13:01Z, outcome: 504 gateway timeout (body: \"gateway: request queue capacity exceeded\").

jamie_sre: Observed same spike on gateway in us-west-2. Metrics: hosted.batcher.queue_depth{hostpool=hp-usw2-3} jumped from ~95 to ~210 while configured hard limit is 180. We started seeing early_reject and eviction logs around 15:13:04Z. Continuous-batcher backlog growth + slower decode due to K/V cold miss.

maria_eng: Any recent deploys or config changes for hp-usw2-3?

dan_runtime: There was a model micro-rollout rwd-3b@v2 at 06:50 PDT. No queue config changes. Also noticed acme increased their async parallelism last night (they said they ramped to 60 workers). Longer seqs in requests (~1100 tokens). Likely compounding.

alex_oncall: Grab the trace for rq_20260402_acme_A1 and the batcher pod logs. Also check kvcache.miss_rate.

jamie_sre: Trace shows two queue stages: ingress queue waited 2.8s, then batcher queue wait 3.9s before decode started. Batcher log excerpt: 

jamie_sre: ```
[2026-04-02T15:13:02Z] INFO batcher[hp-usw2-3]: enqueue rq_20260402_acme_A1 seq_len=1100 tenant=acme
[2026-04-02T15:13:04Z] WARN batcher[hp-usw2-3]: queue_depth=189 hard_limit=180 evicting tenant-slot oldest=acme
[2026-04-02T15:13:05Z] ERROR batcher[hp-usw2-3]: early_reject id=rq_20260402_acme_A7 reason=queue_capacity_exceeded
```

maria_eng: Evictions cause tail retries which pile up and overload the gateway; we need immediate mitigations plus medium and long-term controls.

support-liaison: Customer prefers us to try infra changes before they throttle. They can reduce concurrency if we ask but would rather keep throughput.

dan_runtime: Proposed immediate infra actions (low-risk first):
1) temporarily raise batcher hard_limit from 180 -> 220 for hp-usw2-3 (monitor memory & kvcache)
2) enable tenant-specific fallback routing for acme to rwd-3b-quant (lower mem/latency) at a p99 threshold
3) enable per-tenant soft-shed that starts rejecting new inflight shards when tenant share > 30% of queue
4) perform a graceful restart of batcher replica bc one pod shows heavy GC spikes

alex_oncall: Do 1 + 2 now. Document the exact commands and watch metrics.

dan_runtime: Running rdctl to bump config: 

dan_runtime: ```bash
# increase hard queue limit for the hostpool batcher
kubectl -n redwood exec deploy/batcher-hp-usw2-3 -- /bin/bash -c \"rdctl config set batcher.hard_limit 220 && rdctl reload\"
```

ops-bot: :rocket: config-change started for batcher-hp-usw2-3 by dan_runtime at 2026-04-02T15:17:22Z

jamie_sre: Watching metrics: hosted.batcher.queue_depth dropped from 210 -> 125 within 4 minutes after the bump and eviction events stopped immediately. p95 token latency improved; p99 remains about 20% above baseline. kvcache.miss_rate climbed briefly but stabilized.

maria_eng: Enabled routing fallback for tenant acme to rwd-3b-quant with a conservative threshold. Policy applied: fallback kicks when tenant_p99_ms > 1400ms.

maria_eng: ```json
{\"tenant\":\"acme\",\"route_policy\":\"fallback:rwd-3b-quant\",\"p99_threshold_ms\":\"1400\"}
```

support-liaison: Customer reports dramatic drop in 5xxs within ~7min. They still see occasional 504s for very long requests but acceptable for now.

alex_oncall: Root cause summary: sudden tenant concurrency increase + longer request seq lengths + model rollout led to sustained queue_depth exceeding configured hard_limit; eviction flow and early_rejects cascaded to gateway timeouts.

Action items (agreed):
- short term: keep hard_limit=220 for 90 minutes, watch memory/kvcache + p99s; keep quant fallback enabled for acme for 24h.
- medium: implement per-tenant soft-shed at 30% queue share and a tenant concurrency cap that is configurable via account settings.
- long term: implement adaptive hostpool autoregulate that scales batcher replicas when avg_queue_depth > 60% for 3m and improve kvcache prewarming during model rollouts. Add integration scenarios that simulate tenant microbursts with long seqs.

jamie_sre: Filed INC-2026-0402-queue-warmup-surge and assigned to eng-runtime for follow-up. Adding runbooks for similar symptoms to \"batcher.eviction -> gateway 504s\".

maria_eng: I'll open a PR for per-tenant soft-shed and add a unit/integration test harness for rollout-related kvcache warmup.

support-liaison: Marking resolved for customer; they'll reopen if they see recurrence. :white_check_mark:

alex_oncall: Final check 2026-04-02T15:42:00Z shows metrics returned near baseline. Closing active triage.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: incident INC-2026-0402-queue-warmup-surge closed by jamie_sre at 2026-04-02T15:58:10Z
